findings.description: The policy grants ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, and cloudwatch:* on every resource to the svc_deploy IAM user. This violates least privilege and includes broad data access and infrastructure-modification permissions; several permitted service actions can also be used in privilege-escalation paths depending on other account resources.

The encrypted secret value of the IAM access key is exported through an output that is not marked sensitive. It may therefore be displayed in Terraform output and propagated to downstream consumers; it is also recorded in Terraform state as credential material.
